title: Multi-Agent IT Operations Platform
description: Enterprise-grade AI platform automating critical IT workflows — change management, incident response, database operations, and report generation — via multi-agent orchestration. Uses hybrid RAG (Qdrant + Neo4j) and a 29-rule human-in-the-loop governance engine.

title: Support AI Chatbot
description: Slack-based Support AI streamlining customer support with NLP, vector search, and multi-agent orchestration. Automates ticket creation, reduces duplicates via AI auto-responder, and maintains a self-improving FAQ system.

title: Air Cargo Management Platform
description: Comprehensive platform maximizing visibility and service quality within the air cargo industry. Streamlines truck scheduling, check-in, and gate operations with event-driven workflows via Azure Service Bus.

title: Smart Bidding Assistant
description: Web-based bidding assistant that processes client requirement documents and bid files. Automates document summarization using LLMs and recommends the most suitable developers via semantic search and ranking.

title: AI Career Upskilling Agent
description: AI platform generating personalized step-by-step learning roadmaps from user skills and goals. Features feedback-driven roadmap regeneration, external learning material matching, and async background processing.

title: HR Management System
description: Comprehensive HRMS covering recruitment, employee self-service, payroll processing, e-learning, and finance modules. Integrated third-party APIs for payroll and benefits with strong security and compliance.

title: Document OCR Platform
description: Web application enabling users to upload and scan document images, converting them to structured text using OCR. Leverages YOLO-based region detection to segment headers, tables, and text blocks before recognition.

title: M365 Mailbox Automation Portal
description: Service portal automating M365 mailbox lifecycle management including creation, deletion, licensing, billing reports, and message usage tracking. Exposed as API endpoints for external system integration.

title: Internal ERP System
description: Internal web application for company-wide use covering human resource management, project tracking, daily reporting, and business data analytics. Built on MVC architecture with unit and integration testing.
